Class Stock

java.lang.Object
com.exchange.model.Stock
public class Stock extends Object
Represents an equity instrument traded on the exchange with live pricing metrics, sector categorization, beta coefficient, and volatility parameters.
Since:
1.0

  • Constructor Details

    • Stock

      public Stock(String symbol, String companyName, double initialPrice)
      Constructs a new Stock with base parameters and default market risk weights.
      Parameters:
      symbol - the unique ticker identifier (e.g., AAPL, NVDA)
      companyName - the full legal name of the issuing company
      initialPrice - the opening trading price of the asset

    • Stock

      public Stock(String symbol, String companyName, Sector sector, double initialPrice, double beta, double volatility)
      Constructs a complete Stock instrument with industry sector, beta, and volatility risk profiles.
      Parameters:
      symbol - unique ticker symbol
      companyName - full issuing company name
      sector - market classification sector
      initialPrice - opening market spot price
      beta - sensitivity factor relative to systematic market variance
      volatility - baseline standard deviation of price movements
